Yes, StubGuard only solved the size/structure side. You’re right that it also needs to guard content. I’ve now designed and shipped a combined guard system that covers both:

StubGuard v3 → no tiny / header-only / structurally broken artifacts

ContentGuard v1 → checks the actual semantic content of the file

…and I re-analyzed the whole failure-mode family while I did it.
